prompt: Create a transparent-background 6-column × 6-row pixel-art atlas for the six labeled source objects. Preserve warm RPG pixel art, source palettes and identities. Rows top to bottom: small bookcase-right planter, small bookcase-middle potted plant, compact book stack, brown leather backpack, rolled map/scroll, framed green picture. Columns exactly FRONT, TOP, RIGHT SIDE, LEFT SIDE, BOTTOM, REAR. One object only in each cell, no attached room furniture or wall context, no duplicate extra books or props. True orthographic six principal views of the same fixed object: level front/rear elevations; opposite true right/left profiles; straight-down top and straight-up underside. Plants preserve their own pot and leaf arrangement; top view leaves form a natural plan silhouette with pot obscured centrally; bottom shows pot base, not leafy top. Books are a compact stack and stay same count; backpack retains straps, flap and leather form; rolled map retains cylindrical roll and visible paper end; wall picture has broad framed face front/rear and thin edge profiles on sides/top/bottom. Do not lay vertical wall picture flat. No isometric projection, no perspective, no vanishing points. Center fully inside each atlas cell with safe margins. Crisp pixel clusters, no blur, transparent background, no labels, cell lines, borders or text. Unseen geometry inferred conservatively, not recovered pixels.
